subject: 辽金北方匿名佛寺殿堂（原创扩展）
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: tianshu building-map sprite bld_kit_liao_jin_north_temple_hall. Generate ONE NEW anonymous Liao-Jin northern Buddhist temple hall (original game interpretation), not an edit of the reference building. The supplied Song image is STYLE AND CAMERA REFERENCE ONLY: match its realistic historical game asset rendering, individual grey clay roof tiles, warm muted wood and plaster, fine believable material grain, detail density, clean transparency. Change architecture to a broad, weighty Datong Liao-Jin timber hall: single-eave five-ridged hipped roof, low broad sweeping eaves, prominent robust timber brackets, restrained dark ochre-red columns, pale warm earth-plastered side wall, simple straight wood lattice doors, tiny plain weathered ridge finials, raised but restrained stone podium with a central front stair. No Qing painted decoration. Ground footprint 13 east-west by 10 north-south units. Crucial orthographic camera yaw 45 degrees pitch 30 degrees with exact 2:1 ground rhombus; visible ground edge slopes +0.5 and -0.5, vertical columns, parallel lines, entrance faces SCREEN LOWER LEFT. Make the foundation ground-plane parallelogram clearly measurable with left/right/front corners. Thin flat ground skirt only, not a thick floating island or diorama cube. One complete isolated object centered with generous transparent margins; all roof tips and base fully visible. Soft light from image upper left, short contact shadow lower right. TRUE RGBA transparent background, no drawn checkerboard, no background or sky. No people, animals, text, numbers, signs, watermark, labels, extra structures, statues outside, courtyard, plants or props. Single static orientation. Keep hall silhouette broad; the roof is not a tall pagoda.
REGENERATE with focused correction: foundation has EXACTLY 2:1 projected orthographic footprint. The front-most bottom ground corner must be noticeably lower so both ground sides form 26.565 degrees with screen horizontal. Leftmost foundation point (20%,60%), frontmost point (57%,85%), rightmost point (85%,65%) is only approximate framing; do not flatten edges. More important: a TRUE single-eave HIP roof (wudian), roof slopes down on all four sides, NO triangular vertical gable and NO secondary gabled roof mass. Keep brackets large and dark and roof pitch lower. Render anonymous Datong Liao-Jin form, not a copy of the Song reference. Do not add an opaque halo.
negative: 文字、伪字、人物、现代物、背景、棋盘格、厚浮岛、透视、裁切、长阴影、清式彩画
